**Argentina gets taste of global data-centre boom: Buenos Aires Times**
Argentina has 67 registered data centres, 52 of them operational and 13 announced projects, the Buenos Aires Times reports, as a global build-out of digital infrastructure reaches the country. The government is looking at billions of dollars of investment in that infrastructure. The Times reports mounting concern over energy use, water consumption and job creation.
